_settings: Not here: the app's switches (Quick panel keys quickKey and switchKey, clipboard limits quickMax, quickDays and quickSecret, idle sleep textIdleMin and voiceIdleMin) are in Settings and data/settings.json; the theme is in Settings > Look and data/look.json (docs/themes.md).
_about: Copy to data/drafter.local.json (never in git) and fill in. Every key is optional: with no file the Claude prompts say "the user" and every private integration is off. engine/local.py and app/LocalConfig.swift read it; `.venv/bin/python engine/local.py` prints what is in effect.
